claim_id.description: A UUID in the lowercase canonical form of RFC 9562. Lowercase hex never begins with the reserved v1.3 prefixes B, S or R.

sha256.description: A SHA-256 digest of exact stored bytes, as 64 lowercase hex characters.

commit_sha.description: A full git commit SHA-1, as 40 lowercase hex characters.

relative_path.description: A forward-slash path relative to a root: not empty, no leading slash, no backslash, no empty, '.' or '..' segment.

text.description: Non-empty text containing at least one non-whitespace character.
